thread:
sam: Quick callout 1: lets ship the FastStart refapp this week. Goals: tiny tutorial, demo webinar, a 15s benchmark clip for socials, and clear lead tagging. Who volunteers for which chunk?
elaine: Ill take the blog + 3-step tutorial. Aim for Build in 5 minutes messaging and code-first examples. ETA Tues morning.
omar: Ill scaffold the repo and CI. Plan: one Dockerfile, one example, one test. Will add a tiny Makefile. ETA EOD today.
jin: Ill own the benchmark story + visuals. Thinking: small matrix comparing hosted vs local cost/latency on a 512-token workload. Need repo artifacts from omar.
sophie: Ill run the webinar ops and spin up the registration page. Recommend Wed 11am PT. Also set up calendar + recording.
sam: Nice. Keep the dependency list to a minimum (<=2 libs). Also we should include a single-command start: `curl -s https://... | bash` or `docker run`.
omar: Repo layout proposal:
```
faststart-refapp/
  README.md
  quickstart.md
  demo.js
  Dockerfile
  .github/workflows/ci.yml
```
Ill include a one-liner to run locally and a small env file.
jin: For visuals Ill export 2 PNGs + a short mp4 gif (15s) showing latency bar and token throughput. Also a small table for the blog.
sophie: Inbound flow: registrants -> 3-email nurture -> label in CRM `faststart_interest` -> SDR alert if opened demo link. Ill draft the email cadence.
elaine: Drafting short blog now. Will include sections: Why FastStart, Quickstart (code), Benchmark snapshot, Next steps (webinar + GitHub). Will keep it ~700 words.
sam: Messaging note: call out "Works on Redwood Hosted, Dedicated, and in local dev". Also include a short quote from eng (one line) about performance.
omar: Adding CONTRIBUTING.md and a badge for one-click deploy. Also tiny LICENSE (MIT).
jin: Can someone give me a sample input (50 tokens) to run microbenchmarks?
elainE: (typo) meant: Ill paste sample prompt in the repo.
sophie: Event created: Wed 11am PT. Placeholder speakers: sam + omar. Recording enabled. Landing page: https://events.redwood.ai/faststart (placeholder).
deploy-bot: CI passed on branch faststart/init.
sam: Action items recap: omar - repo + CI (today). elaine - blog + tutorial (Tues AM). jin - benchmarks + GIF (Tues). sophie - webinar + emails (Tues). Ill draft social copy and headline.
omar: One more ask  keep examples non-proprietary and easy to remix.
elaine: Will include a tiny "customize in 3 steps" section.
jin: Ill prepare alt text and short captions for the PNGs for accessibility.
sophie: Ill wire UTMs: utm_source=faststart&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=faststart_launch and set tracking in the landing page.
sam: Great. Lets keep Slack updates brief; drop PR links here when ready. :rocket:
